motivation.problem: Under FREEZE_V1 axes the grid archives are structurally capped: exhaustive truth occupies 4/100 S_structural_2d@10 cells and 2/100 B_behavior_2d@10 cells, so any MAP-Elites-family archive can retain at most 4 (resp. 2) elites regardless of search quality. Production MZ-D3 confirmed saturation (S/B cell recovery 0.0-1.0 with <=5 elites retained).
motivation.lever: Finer resolution and/or higher-dimensional descriptor axes: S_structural_3d@10, S_structural_2d@20, B_behavior_2d@20, and CVT-64 over S_DIMS with exhaustive deterministic centroids (replacing the arm's 500-sample centroids with census truth for scoring).
motivation.scope: Denominators change; therefore this numbered amendment is mandatory before any new scored run (freeze discipline). Budget, seeds, evaluation, objectives, and the Pareto denominator (387) are unchanged from FREEZE_V1.

controls_reverified.note: bit-identical re-derivation of FREEZE_V1 denominators; controls MUST equal FREEZE_V1 census_truth_P00 or the amendment is void

census_truth_P00B.interpretation_note: Resolution alone does NOT lift the cap: S2d@20 still occupies 4 cells because unit_type_entropy takes exactly 1 distinct value across all 14904 feasible genomes. The amended ceilings are intrinsic descriptor-function degeneracy under CENSUS_BOUND_V1: max 8 distinguishable S cells (3d), 4 B cells, 18 CVT niches (k-means on 14904 exhaustive points collapses k=64 to 18 distinct centroids, all occupied).

scoring_rules_amend1.uniform_recompute: Every arm's retained elites are re-evaluated and their descriptors recomputed from genomes; cell recovery is then measured on ALL amended axes: S3d@10 (denominator 8), B2d@20 (denominator 4), CVT census niches (denominator 18, nearest exhaustive census centroid).
scoring_rules_amend1.pareto_recovery: unchanged: exact-Pareto phenotype set of 387 from FREEZE_V1 census_truth_P00
comparisons: same_cpu_hour (wall-clock x cores reported per arm)

If S/B/CVT cell counts still saturate at the amended ceilings, the obstruction is proven to be descriptor-function degeneracy (structural under CENSUS_BOUND_V1), not grid resolution and not search failure.
